The published Compiler Explorer link compiles godbolt-source.hlsl in five panes.
CE runs Linux Release builds of dxc_trunk and dxc_1_6_2112; this replays the same
command lines against the local build, so the link and this triage measure the same
thing. The fifth pane is an old release and has no local counterpart -- the release
history is covered by `triage.py bisect` instead.
Read the 'control' rows first: they are the same compiler and the same stage as the
row above them, with the semantic moved into a cell the table already marks NA.
# dxc: <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe

--- accepted: ds_6_4 DSOutMain ---

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain godbolt-source.hlsl

  %15 = call float @dx.op.loadInput.f32(i32 4, i32 0, i32 0, i8 3, i32 1)  ; LoadInput(inputSigId,rowIndex,colIndex,gsVertexAxis)
